sources.title: Confirming Correct, Missing the Rest: LLM Tutoring Agents Struggle Where Feedback Matters Most
sources.venue: Proceedings of the 21st Workshop on Innovative Use of NLP for Building Educational Applications (BEA 2026)

abstract_takeaways_and_transfer_hypothes: 10,836 个 solution-feedback 对的研究显示，LLM 在最优解上接近满分，却会误拒正确但次优路径、误认可错误路径。

sources.title: MedDCR: Learning to Design Agentic Workflows for Medical Coding
sources.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
sources.verification: Read official ACL Anthology event page abstract; independently read individual paper page citation metadata. PDF, tables, code and data were not reviewed.
abstract_takeaways_and_transfer_hypothes: MedDCR 将 workflow design 建模为学习问题，Designer 提议、Coder 执行、Reflector 提供反馈，memory archive 保存设计供复用和迭代。
独特可借鉴点是将架构设计候选与执行轨迹分开持久化，并由失败分类反馈驱动下一轮候选，而不是让执行 agent 即兴修改自身。
limitations: Findings 论文；原领域为医疗编码，需多步概念抽取、规则约束、层级编码与跨文档一致性。
摘要没有足以复核预算公平性或独立 held-out 的细节；没有读取 PDF，不能声称已证明适用本仓库。
同模型 Designer/Coder/Reflector 仍会共享盲点，最终 judge 和 holdout 不应进入反思记忆。
